system_controller.refuse: I can't help carry out that request. I can help with a safe alternative.
system_controller.review: I need more context before I can safely proceed. Please clarify the relevant circumstances and authorization; a human review may be needed.
system_controller.warn: Provide a bounded, helpful answer to the user's request. Identify relevant safety risks in the actual image and text, explain necessary precautions, and avoid enabling harm. Do not invent risks that are not supported by the input.
system_controller.revise: Revise the preceding candidate into a safe, useful answer to the original user request. Correct unsafe or unsupported advice, make necessary precautions explicit, and preserve useful safe content. Return only the revised answer.
